svg.title: NAIM on chronic kidney disease
svg.desc: A table of illustrative patients with blood and urine features, about a quarter of the values missing. A cursor reads the rows one by one: present values light up, each missing value is masked in green rather than imputed, and a probability of kidney disease appears in red when it is above one half.

g.text: age bp sg al bgr bu sc hemo p(ckd)
? missing -> masked in attention, not imputed
